schoolName: The University of the West Indies, Cave Hill
reviewNotes: HOLD - The official Faculty of Medical Sciences page describes a five-year MBBS, with three pre-clinical years and two clinical years, and the 2025/26 official fee booklet publishes fee bands. The current admissions page says MBBS applications are not open for the 2026/27 cycle. A separate official page describes a three-year BSc Preclinical Sciences pathway articulated to the University of Ghana MB ChB, so the eventual published content must clearly distinguish that route from the Cave Hill MBBS. Hold pending a future-cycle admissions route, a complete programme-cost card, current clinical-site evidence and target-market recognition checks.
